lines.en: How fast did the winning car go?
lines.zh: 获胜的赛车开得有多快？

lines.en: Once a year, a race is held for old cars.
lines.zh: 每年一度，都会举行一次老爷车比赛。

lines.en: A lot of cars entered for this race last year and there was a great deal of excitement just before it began.
lines.zh: 去年，许多汽车报名参加了这场比赛，比赛开始前气氛异常热烈。

lines.en: One of the most handsome cars was a Rolls-Royce Silver Ghost.
lines.zh: 其中一辆最漂亮的车是劳斯莱斯“银灵”。

lines.en: The most unusual car was a Benz which had only three wheels.
lines.zh: 最不寻常的车是一辆只有三个轮子的奔驰车。

lines.en: Built in 1885, it was the oldest car taking part.
lines.zh: 它建于1885年，是参赛车辆中最老的一辆。

lines.en: After a great many loud explosions, the race began.
lines.zh: 在一阵阵巨大的轰鸣声之后，比赛开始了。

lines.en: Many of the cars broke down on the course and some drivers spent more time under their cars than in them!
lines.zh: 许多汽车在赛道上抛锚了，有些司机待在车底的时间比待在车里的时间还长！

lines.en: A few cars, however, completed the race.
lines.zh: 然而，有几辆车完成了比赛。

lines.en: The winning car reached a speed of forty miles an hour -- much faster than any of its rivals.
lines.zh: 获胜的赛车达到了每小时40英里的速度——比任何竞争对手都要快得多。

lines.en: It sped downhill at the end of the race and its driver had a lot of trouble trying to stop it.
lines.zh: 在比赛结束时，它向下冲刺，司机费了很大的劲才把它停下来。

lines.en: The race gave everyone a great deal of pleasure.
lines.zh: 这场比赛给每个人带来了极大的乐趣。

lines.en: It was very different from modern car races but no less exciting.
lines.zh: 它与现代汽车比赛大相径庭，但同样激动人心。
